enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with air conditioner on to stay cool during heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn on air conditioner. Press power button. Set temperature to 22 degrees. Adjust fan speed to medium. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Sleep.
Enter bathroom. Turn on faucet. Pick up soap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Dry face with towel. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, staying hydrated
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Pour milk into glass. Drink water. Eat breakfast. Wash dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Show ID. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in with password. Open email. Read emails. Reply to email. Stand up. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Listen to heartbeat. Take blood pressure. Record data. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Open patient file. Update notes.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Take off shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir meat. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn on air conditioner. Press power button. Set temperature. Adjust fan speed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Type website. Scroll. Click link. Watch video. Type comment. Post comment. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Exit bathroom.
Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
